breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the conflict by keeping the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid and dropping the gamma-centered instruction. However, the generated specification does the opposite — it specifies a gamma-centered 4x4x4 Monkhorst-Pack grid with no mention of a half shift, which contradicts the ground truth's resolution of this inconsistency.
